Guides / 2026-05-08

Are Sauna Hats Worth It?

A no-mysticism answer to when sauna hats help, when they do not, and who should skip them.

Sauna hats are worth it if your head gets hot before the rest of your body is done with the round.

That is the whole argument.

The Case For One

In a hot room, your head is often closest to the ceiling. Your scalp and ears meet the sharpest air first. A sauna hat creates a buffer so your body can keep warming after your head would usually tell you to leave.

For regular sauna users, that can make a real difference.

When It Is Not Worth It

If you only sit in mild rooms, take short sessions, or never feel heat spike around your head, a sauna hat may not change much.

It also will not fix a bad room, poor ventilation, dehydration, or staying in too long.

Who Benefits Most

  • People who sit on upper benches.
  • People with longer hair.
  • People whose ears get hot quickly.
  • People doing multiple heat and cold cycles.
  • People who use wood-fired or very hot public saunas.

What To Spend

Buy for material first. Dense wool felt is usually worth paying more for than novelty shape, embroidery, or a clever line on the front.

A sauna hat should make the round better. Everything else is decoration.
